character: Silverstone's 2.98km International Circuit — the southern loop of the Grand Prix track. It mixes the fast Hamilton and Hangar straights and the quick Abbey and Stowe with two very slow, technical sections at Village and Vale, which makes it feel stop-start. The Link joins Village straight to Becketts, replacing the seven GP corners in between.
sources: https://www.racingcircuits.info/europe/united-kingdom/silverstone.html ; https://oversteer48.com/silverstone-circuit-configurations/ — International Circuit (1.85mi/2.98km, 8 corners): Abbey, Farm Curve, Village, The Link, Becketts, Stowe, Vale, Club

corners.name: Abbey
corners.technique: Lift or light brake, smooth turn-in, use the bump on the apex as a reference
corners.trap: Using too much exit road compromises the run to Farm

corners.name: Farm Curve
corners.technique: Flat or near-flat, smooth inputs, keep the car settled through the kink
corners.trap: A sudden lift causes lift-off oversteer at high speed

corners.name: Village
corners.technique: Hard braking, late apex for a good exit onto the Link
corners.trap: Early apex leads to running wide and a slow exit

corners.name: The Link
corners.type: connecting section joining Village to Becketts (unique to this layout)
corners.technique: Settle the car and carry momentum through toward the Becketts complex
corners.trap: Wasting the short link with a poor Village exit

corners.name: Becketts
corners.technique: Flow through with smooth, quick direction changes — carry as much speed as possible
corners.trap: Fighting the car with big corrections instead of finding rhythm

corners.name: Stowe
corners.technique: Brake in a straight line, hit the apex, use the exit kerb
corners.trap: Braking too late on the downhill approach

corners.name: Vale
corners.technique: Multiple braking references, patient entry — a good exit sets up Club

corners.name: Club
corners.type: fast right onto the pit straight (final corner)
corners.technique: Long vision through the corner — exit from Vale is critical for straight-line speed
corners.trap: A poor Vale exit means slow Club and slow pit-straight speed
